newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Macmed buys two firms for 17 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Macmed buys two firms for 17 mln rand.

text.p: Macmed Health Care Ltd said on Friday it had bought Sherwood Medical (Pty) Ltd and Hospital Equipment Manufacturers (Pty) Ltd (Hemco) with effect from April 1 for a total of 17.23 million rand.

The Sherwood price of 10.23 million rand would be settled by the issue of 3.72 million Macmed shares at an issue price of 275 cents each. The Hemco acquisition, valued at seven million rand, would be settled by the issue of 2.55 million shares at an issue price of 275 cents.
It said the agreement was subject to conditions precedent which included approval by the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

Macmed said if the acquisition had been effective throughout the six months ended September 30, 1996, and based on half of Sherwood and Hemco's unaudited profit after tax for the 12 months ending February 28, 1997, the earning per share would have increased by 1.8 cents, or 28 percent, to 8.3 cents.
Sherwood supplies capital equipment and hospital furniture to new or renovated hospitals in Africa and Macmed said this would enhance its export drive into Africa and the world.
Hemco manufactures a full range of hospital furniture and equipment.
